summary: First backend integration test iteration for Fotuber. All 14 backend tests pass covering auth (register/login/me/kvkk/unauth), services (seed count>=5 and admin CRUD), availability (11 hourly slots 09:00-19:00), full appointment workflow (pending->approved with kapora->slot becomes booked), conflict handling (second customer 409 on approved slot), blocked-slots (customer 409 on blocked slot, non-admin 403), staff CRUD, reports/summary (all keys + revenue_series with 7 entries), gallery categories (6), admin image upload -> list -> file download (bytes returned), non-admin upload 403 and admin-guard enforcement.

minor.issue: Past-time comparison uses UTC for both slot_dt and 'now'; in Turkey (UTC+3) this may mark slots as booked slightly earlier/later than local intent. Not blocking today's tests since we use a date 3 days ahead.
Emails are silently lowercased server-side (good practice), but response does not echo back what was submitted verbatim. Frontend should be aware and normalize before display.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines and getting large - consider splitting routers (auth, gallery, appointments, admin) into separate modules for maintainability.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. Works with browsers because Starlette reflects Origin, but tighten to explicit domains for production.
put_object/get_object in gallery are synchronous requests.* calls inside async endpoints - blocks the event loop for large uploads. Consider offloading via run_in_executor or an async HTTP client.

In /api/appointments PATCH, only status=='approved' checks for conflicts; if admin manually changes date/time via other means (currently not exposed), double-booking is possible. Fine as-is because only status/deposit/paid/notes are updatable.
OPENING_HOUR/CLOSING_HOUR hard-coded (09-20). Should be config-driven for future flexibility.
seed_data_creation: Tests dynamically create TEST_ prefixed users, services, staff, blocked-slots, appointments, gallery items. Cleanup handled inline for gallery, blocked-slots, staff, services, appointments. TEST_ customer accounts remain in DB (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. When re-running, use TEST_DATE = today+3 days to avoid the past-time booked flag. Emergent object storage upload works reliably (~2-3s). Admin login returns role='admin', customer register returns role='customer'. Availability returns 11 slots 09:00..19:00 inclusive. Approved appointments mark slot booked in availability. All admin routes correctly return 403 for customer role, and 401 without any auth. Cookies set with SameSite=None; Secure. Bearer header preferred for backend tests to avoid cookie session collisions between fixtures.
rca of the issue: Only one initial test failure due to test-side assertion comparing raw vs lowercased email; fixed by comparing against email.lower(). No backend defects found.
